body:
[UrlProtocol PR](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/pull/992) needs host shutdown to complete when a full native event-loop queue rejects close work. Its review found that a failed listener close skipped upstream acceptor-group cleanup; expanded coverage then found a second gap: an outbound QUIC UDP parent remained open and registered after its own event loop terminated.

F93c resumes the user's request to “close the UDP-parent gap inside jvm-libp2p, finish the coverage gaps and the gate, publish the corrected snapshot.” The source corrections and permanent regressions are pushed at [f6326b65a300814f96d871c1009f14f1f9e87e46](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/commit/f6326b65a300814f96d871c1009f14f1f9e87e46), but the work is **unfinished and no corrected snapshot is published**.

QUIC shutdown closes rejected live children on their owning loop before their separately owned UDP parent, retaining both original dispatch errors and native-close outcomes. A first transport close after group termination still reports the original rejected connection close. Repeated transport shutdown keeps one private result and independent caller observers; distinct child/parent failures remain reachable, including when suppression is disabled. Listener registration checks closed state under the shutdown inventory lock, queued binds report `Transport is closed` with their underlying cause, and a dial visitor that stops the transport prevents later connection publication. No Netty code or dependency artifact changes were needed. After native loop rejection, the contract is physical closure, a completed physical close future and the reported failure; native deregistration is not required.

Validation:

- Permanent register: **34/34 actual first-attempt passes**, zero skips/retries, after an unchanged rebase onto `develop`436997d5. This uses source overlays and native JUnit with retries unavailable against the freshly byte-verified snapshot45 base. Formatting was applied with the pinned ktlint1.1.1 configuration; formatter exit0. This is not a full local Gradle build.
- Original rejected-parent case: red0/1, green1/1, removed-fix red0/1. Live-child rejection: red0/1 then green1/1. Terminated-group original-error retention: red0/1, green1/1, removed-fix red0/1. The final four native/bind/listener/retention cases pass4/4.
- Dial visitor: red0/1 then green1/1. Held bind: red0/1, first correction still red0/1, corrected green1/1. Late listener: red0/1 on retained activeListeners=1, corrected green1/1.
- Multiple child/parent errors: pre-aggregation847b63f3 control red0/1 on missing exact child failure, current implementation green1/1. F93b's repeated-result and secondary-error red/green/red evidence remains linked below.
- Broader evidence-only inventory run:35/36 first-attempt passes. The WS four-listener/32-root draft failed its physical close/unregister assertion and was not adopted; it was not retried. The long-lived QUIC churn reproducer is red0/1 and remains unfixed.
- **30x gate:0/1020**, for34 permanent cases. It did not run within the reporting window and slot waits. No artifact publication is permitted by these incomplete results.
- Actions XML on the earlier702b3800 head:1581/1587 first-attempt passes,4 failures,2 existing skips, retried tests=[]; all242 XML files were read. Three unchanged tests fail final stop cleanup after a deliberately retained shutdown failure (`ParentCloseOwnershipTest.failedCloseIsReturnedToEveryOwnerWithoutAnotherRequest`, `ConnectionCloseRetryTest.transportOwnedFailureCanBeRetriedWithoutChangingOrdinaryResult`, `ConnectionCloseRetryTest.concurrentRetriesShareHeldAttemptAndIsolateCallerFutureChanges`). `NoisePreparationLifecycleTest.stop reentered from readiness prevents empty listener startup` reports a timeout and remains unclassified. Its full trace is retained in evidence. Formatting also failed on that earlier head and is corrected by the formatting commit. **Final-head Actions XML is not yet available; no green Actions verdict is claimed.**

[R93a ledger](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/blob/996be90fb23040717da7974bbec39aa5443d9b98/evidence/R93a/review.md) gap1 (repeated shutdown) and gap2 (multiple cleanup errors) are covered. The concrete Netty group always completes its termination future successfully; the requested group-failure fixture is refuted by the exact implementation in the evidence. Gap3 still lacks an actual full-queue transport test, gap4 lacks the remaining handshake/failed-dial inventory dimensions, and gap5 lacks the churn correction and flat heap/descriptor/thread curves. Two whole-file independent review reports were completed; no final clean-review claim is made after the last changes.

**Existing default-branch tests edited: none.** The prior PR-added F93bQuicTerminatedLoopTest now asserts its previously ignored successful graceful-shutdown result, in a dedicated commit. All other edits to prior PR-added tests are pinned formatting only; no assertion was weakened. The formatting commit touches22 PR source/test files; exact file lists are in evidence. The unchanged main-test cleanup expectations above conflict with retained failed shutdown results; this brief prohibits changing those fixtures, so no main-test edit was attempted.

Already published: `community.kotlin.libp2p:jvm-libp2p:1.3.0-codexcoder21-snapshot-45`, from [e3e5caf4a0d5cfc1acd40be2ec7468078ce9f8fe](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/commit/e3e5caf4a0d5cfc1acd40be2ec7468078ce9f8fe). Local/downloaded JAR SHA-256 `a2c9e25b16c69d83bdd813648c447d74bf549ec9a5eaad83cdb51c53a3b19a2c`; all1107 entries and POM bytes verified in [FLIBP8](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/ebcb5f2d737554c506bab6c070ba33a4c6c09b0e/evidence/FLIBP8).45 is untouched;46 initially returned404 but was neither reserved nor published. F93c published none.

[F93c evidence](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/wip/F93c-evidence-20261105/evidence/F93c) includes exact first-attempt XML, controls, reviews, failing drafts and final findings. [F93b evidence](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/70b876d0a024ab8204002633671cf9ab9c646262/evidence/F93b) preserves its earlier test-first proofs. Default develop remains436997d5 with no equivalent fix. No merge, enqueue, close, deployment, check rerequest or handoff command was performed.
